title: RFSweepParserConfig
description: Settings needed to parsed an RFsweep.

instr_timing_tolerance.description: Used for determining the relative time delays between the instrument signals for finding the 'correct' RF switching time. A typical value is 5 seconds.

stats_window_override.description: Override the stats window (in seconds) to average over when evaluating long timescale RF off values. If not provided will use the stats_window size in the measurement configuration.

fast_off_analysis.description: Enables performance of fast off analysis for thermoelectric sensors. Usually only DUTs, if provided must provided V_off settings.

V_off_delay.description: What time should be used when evaluating the V_off fit to find the off value, time is relative to when power is switched off. Only needed for DUTs

V_off_function.description: What type of fit function to use when fitting to the fast off voltage of the sensor. Only needed for DUTs

V_off_fit_time_window.description: The time window - relative to when power was turned off - to fit the data to. Should be large enough to capture the curve. Only needed for DUTs.
